description: The Extraction Core Sample: Proportional supply shift streamgraph.
methodology: Idiom Engineering: Implemented a 100% normalized stacked area chart (streamgraph) to visualize the relative change in water source reliance. Data was aggregated from the Victorian Water Accounts. Interaction: Developed a custom 'Interactive Probe' using a point selection on the X-axis (Water Year) to trigger a dynamic vertical rule and text callouts, allowing for precise forensic sampling of supply strata over time.
citation: Victorian State Government. (2026). Victorian Water Accounts 2022-23: Total use by resource. Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action.
